title: Zooted Cyber Stix - Granddaddy Purple Halloween

clips.prompt: Slow push in toward the haunted mansion on the hill, full moon behind it, jack-o'-lanterns flickering on the steps, a bright lightning flash lights up the sky followed by rolling thunder. Wind and crickets. No dialogue.

Slow steady push in on the oil portrait of Granddaddy Purple above the fireplace. Candles flicker, fire crackles, dust floats. At the end, the painted eyes in the portrait slowly shift and look directly at the camera. Creepy creak sound. No dialogue.

Granddaddy Purple steps out of the portrait frame and down onto the parlor floor, brushes dust off his shoulder and fixes his cuffs, then a quick close-up on his hand as he straightens his gold signet ring, the Zo logo facing camera. He looks at camera and says in {voice}: "You thought I was gone?"

Tracking shot: Granddaddy Purple strolls through the parlor with his cane. As he walks past each candle, its flame flickers and turns purple. A cartoon skeleton and a cartoon vampire playing cards at a table stop and tip their hats to him. He says in {voice}: "Nah. I been right here the whole time."

Granddaddy Purple settles into the big leather chair by the fire, reaches into his jacket and pulls out the purple Cyber Stix device; camera pushes into a close-up of the device in his hand with the Zo ring also in frame, the gold oil catching the firelight. He says in {voice}: "Granddaddy's back. Got a new look, too."

Granddaddy Purple takes a slow pull from the device, then leans toward the camera and blows a thick billowing purple cloud straight at the lens until the cloud completely fills the frame. His mouth is busy exhaling, he does NOT speak on camera. Off-screen voiceover in {voice}: "Two grams. Live resin. No post."

The purple cloud rolls through the room. Granddaddy Purple leans back in the leather chair, gives a small cool nod to the camera and says in {voice}: "Happy Halloween." Then he dissolves completely into the purple smoke, leaving the chair empty.
